title: The Annual Review
content: At the end of the fiscal year, the company's leadership gathered for a conference to review overall performance. The CEO began by praising the workforce for their remarkable efforts. She noted that every individual had played a role in the success, but one employee in particular had received a promotion and a special award for her innovative ideas. The finance team then had to disburse funds for bonuses, ensuring every invoice was paid on time. They also applied a tax deduction to each payment. The CEO reminded everyone that while financial capital is an important asset, the true foundation of the company is its people. To improve future results, the company would conduct training sessions on ethical decision-making. She stressed that it is essential to treat every team member as a valuable part of the base, without discounting their contributions. The meeting was a clear demonstration (using conduct as a noun) of how effective management can lead to shared success.

title: Building a Startup
content: When Maria started her own tech firm, she knew that human capital was her greatest asset. She carefully built a small but skilled workforce, treating each employee as a unique individual with essential talents. Her first major task was to conduct market research to understand customer needs. After receiving seed money from an investor, she had to disburse the capital carefully, paying every invoice for software and rent without asking for a discount from suppliers. The foundation of her business plan was a remarkable new app, which she hoped would lead to a quick promotion for her brand in the tech world. She made all major decisions (using decision-making as a noun) herself, but always sought feedback. Six months later, her hard work paid off when she won an award for young entrepreneurs. At the award ceremony, she gave a speech about the importance of perseverance. "Don't take shortcuts," she said. "Every deduction of time or money from your goal brings you further from success." Looking at the overall picture, Maria knew her journey was just beginning, but the base she had built was solid.
